questions.stem: What is the main advantage of double circulation compared to single circulation?

options.text: It uses less energy because the heart only beats once
It prevents blood from ever becoming deoxygenated
It means blood does not need to pass through capillaries
It allows blood to be pumped at higher pressure to the body

questions.explanation: Double circulation allows blood to return to the heart after visiting the lungs, so it can be pumped out again at high pressure to the body, ensuring efficient delivery of oxygen and nutrients.
